title: Client services, interpretation (language services | research | due diligence | remote)
description:
About Us
Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.Key Responsibilities
You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.The JobYou will manage multiple projects per day.Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).Here’s how you will interact with a project:Scoping
You will speak with clients via email, phone, or We Chat about their needs
You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project
Matchmaking
Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction
Executing
You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied
Key RequirementsBachelor’s degree in a related field
Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plusWorking Hours & LocationThis is afully-remote rolewhere you can work from home ( WFH )
You will work eitherAPAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - Lat Am applicants will work AMER hours)
Weekends and overnights shifts are availablewith a commensurate increase in compensation.Compensation & Benefits
Salary commensurate with experience
Paid time off
Health insurance
Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Pessoa executiva de vendas - shopping parque d. pedro

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Audiovisual | creator
description:
Sobre a Empresa: Já pensou em prestar serviços para uma casa de estratégia e projetos de tecnologia avançada que reúne gente geek, gente criativa, e gente de negócios? A Hagens integra Comunicação, Alta Performance, HX Experience dentro de uma cultura que valoriza ideias, iniciativas, criatividade e, com certeza, as pessoas. Bora voar no nosso foguete!
Estamos localizados no coração de Campinas, em um dos maiores prédios da cidade na Norte Sul. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente de inovação, com profissionais talentosos e criativos que desenvolvem soluções que realmente fazem a diferença.
Na Hagens, operamos em um modelo híbrido, combinando atuação remota com encontros presenciais às terças, quartas e quintas-feiras, ajustáveis conforme necessário.

Sobre a Vaga
Estamos em busca de um talento criativo com olhar apurado para o audiovisual. Se você domina a câmera, respira as tendências das redes sociais, manja de animação (motion) e já está explorando as fronteiras da Inteligência Artificial na criação de conteúdo, essa vaga é para você! Você será o responsável por dar vida visual às nossas ideias, desde a captação até a pós-produção final.

Como vai ser seu dia-dia com a gente: Captação e Produção: Realizar a captação de imagem e áudio para vídeos institucionais, campanhas de marketing e conteúdos do dia a dia. Edição de Vídeo: Editar materiais focados em alta retenção para Reels, Tik Tok, You Tube e Linked In. Motion Graphics: Criar elementos animados, cartelas e efeitos visuais que elevem a qualidade das produções. Estratégia para Redes Sociais: Adaptar roteiros para as linguagens específicas de cada rede, entendendo o que engaja e o que é tendência (trends, áudios em alta, formatos). Inovação com IA: Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar processos (geração de voz, tratamento de áudio, geração de imagens/b-roll ou automação de legendas).
Criação Colaborativa: Participar de brainstormings trazendo sua "veia criativa" para transformar briefings em roteiros visuais dinâmicos.
Requisitos:
Domínio de Softwares de Edição;
Experiência comprovada em captação (uso de câmeras DSLR/Mirrorless, iluminação e microfonia);
Portfólio que demonstre habilidades em Motion Graphics ; Conhecimento profundo dos formatos e algoritmos das redes sociais (Instagram, Tik Tok, You Tube);
Experiência (ou forte interesse) em ferramentas de IA Generativa (como Midjourney, Runway, Eleven Labs, Chat GPT para roteiros, etc.).
Diferenciais: Uso de IA para otimização de fluxo de trabalho (ferramentas de legendagem automática, remoção de ruído por IA ou extensão de cenários). Conhecimento em Color Grading Veia Criativa: Capacidade de propor soluções visuais fora da caixa. Vontade de Aprender: O mundo audiovisual muda toda semana; buscamos alguém que seja "early adopter" de novas tecnologias.
Agilidade e Autonomia: Saber gerenciar prazos e entregas em um ambiente dinâmico.

title: Local project coordinator
description:
To Apply Send a cover letter, resume, three references, and hourly salary requirements in Brazilian Real via e-mail to Consulting Global.org by Wednesday 21 January, 2026 . Please write “Campinas Local Project Coordinator” in the subject line of the e-mail. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. Interviews will take place end of January. If selected, Pyxera Global may elect to use the Local Project Coordinator for future similar assignments.
Overview Pyxera Global (), an NGO with offices around the world, will be managing a skills-based volunteering program in Campinas, Brazil scheduled to take place 8 July – 22 August 2026, with in person dates 15-22 August, 2026. Pyxera Global is looking to hire a part-time Local Project Coordinator currently residing in Campinas to provide project management and logistical support to the selected team of high-level corporate volunteers who will provide pro bono consulting services to local social sector organizations.
The selected Local Project Coordinator’s main responsibilities will include, but may not be limited to, the following:
Project Development & Implementation
Identify and select potential partner organizations (mostly social enterprises and nonprofits) and help to develop Scope of Works (SOWs) reflecting the specific areas of intervention requested by local host client organizations.
Support local partner organizations in preparing for the arrival of corporate volunteers and ensuring stakeholder meetings are arranged.
Participate in conference calls with corporate volunteers in advance of their arrival in Campinas.
Support corporate volunteers, providing advice and guidance around SOW delivery.
Act as the on-the-ground interface between Pyxera Global and partner organizations in Campinas, including regular correspondence with Pyxera Global staff and other stakeholders to assure satisfaction on the part of the corporate volunteers and partner organizations.
Participate in meetings with corporate volunteers and with host client organizations, as requested.
Prepare financial and final program reports.
Logistics
Assist in procuring and negotiating accommodation and transportation in Campinas for corporate volunteers.
Coordinate the program launch and closing event(s) for corporate volunteers and host client organizations.
Prepare Campinas-related guides and suggestions for project guides.
Orient new corporate volunteers upon arrival in Campinas.
Manage project travel logistics for corporate volunteers while they are in Campinas.
Act as a logistical and informational resource for corporate volunteers and troubleshoot challenges they may face.
Monitor and advise on security arrangements for corporate volunteers when they are in Campinas.
Other logistical tasks such as restaurant bookings, photography recruitment, etc.
Knowledge and Skill Requirements
Must be based in Campinas with in-depth area familiarity.
College degree in project management, organizational development, sustainability, NGO management, communications, or related field.
Knowledge or network of NGOs or social enterprises supporting STEM education, skills-trade training, and/or workforce development
Minimum of 5-10 years of experience. Exceptional writing and communications skills.
Ability to conduct Gap and SWOT analysis and to develop consulting Scopes of Work with limited supervision.
Experience working with cross-cultural teams and/or skills-based volunteering programs.
Ability to multi-task and manage diverse tasks simultaneously.
Flexible and able to work in a team, as well as individually with limited supervision.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Fluent in English.
Exceptional customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in virtual and in-person presentation skills.
Salary This is a part-time consultant position with an estimated timeline of 5-6 months with an immediate start date with a Scoping Trip in March with the Program Manager and the program taking place in August. Pay is based on past experience and the type of work required for this position. The selected local project coordinator will be paid in Brazilian Real of the country in which the work is completed.

O Analista de Planejamento de Demanda é responsável por consolidar informações de previsão de vendas e auxiliar na elaboração de previsões confiáveis que suportem decisões estratégicas. Deve garantir que os planos de demanda sejam realistas, identificar riscos e propor ajustes que assegurem o atendimento ao cliente e a eficiência operacional no horizonte de médio prazo.

Preparar materiais e análises para reuniões de demanda, garantindo as informações para tomada de decisão;
Monitorar aderência ao processo de demanda;
Acompanhar o planejamento e propor ajustes tendo em vista as especificidades dos segmentos;
Garantir alinhamento entre áreas comerciais e planejamento, promovendo integração e colaboração;
Apoiar a evolução de ferramentas e processos de forecast, buscando melhoria contínua;
Consolidar dados históricos, projeções de vendas e informações de mercado para elaboração do budget.
QUALIFICAÇÕ ES
Ensino superior completo
Excel intermediário / avançado (Tabela Dinâmica; SOMASEs; PROCX; Power Query)
Experiência com planejamento de demanda
Diferencial:
Conhecimento em Salesforce
Experiência com projetos
Experiência com áreas comerciais

unblemished reputation;

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Fpga engineer (brazil) | engenheiro(a) de fpga (brasil)
description:
The Opportunity
Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.Your Role
Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.Who you are
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
Two (2) to five (5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
Experience with embedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
Experience with high-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2 C, UART, and CAN;
Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
Experience with hardware debug and tests;
Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
Fluency in English, both oral and written.Working Conditions
Competitive Compensation packages
Energizing and supportive work environment
Remote work

_______________________________________________________________OportunidadeOs Engenheiros FPGA da Grass Valley desenvolvem soluções de ponta para criação, transmissão e distribuição de conteúdo. About Bizmoni Corp.

Bizmoni is the worlds first AI Super App designed to help anyone earn, learn, and grow in the AI era. We are building a global, fully remote team to shape the future of financial technology. Our mission is to make powerful AI-driven financial and business tools accessible to everyone from individuals starting side hustles to enterprises scaling globally.

About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and driven MLOps Engineer to design, automate, and optimize our machine learning infrastructure. In this role, you will play a crucial part in bridging the gap between data science and operations by streamlining our AI/ML workflows from experimentation to production.

You will collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, and developers to ensure our models are secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient. Your work will directly impact thousands of users worldwide by enabling real-time, AI-powered financial insights and business solutions.

  • Proven experience as an MLOps Engineer or similar role (fintech or AI startup experience is a plus).
  • Strong programming skills in Python (preferred); familiarity with Java or Scala is a plus.
  • Experience with ML frameworks and pipeline orchestration (MLflow, Airflow, Kubeflow, or SageMaker).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools.
  • Strong understanding of ML algorithms and their real-world applications.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a remote, cross-timezone team environment.
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Why Youll Love Working at Bizmoni:

  • Be part of a mission-driven company building the future of AI-powered FinTech.
  • Fully remote role with a global, diverse team.
  • Equity-based compensation with the potential for future full-time opportunities.
  • Culture of innovation, collaboration, and ownership.

  • Are you open to equity-based compensation?
  • Are you able to dedicate 16 hours weekly to our project?

If your answers are YES , then we are happy to meet you!

  1. Interview with Data Science Department Manager & TA Partner.
  2. Offer (based on final positive feedback).

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços de backend escaláveis, seguros e de alta performance para produtos de software, garantindo qualidade, segurança e ótima experiência do cliente. About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as the main programming language (We will teach you Clojure). Main responsibilities:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS
  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB
  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You will be responsible for

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture
  • Set technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies
  • Drive pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies
  • Mentor engineers across teams, establishing and maintaining a high technical bar organization-wide
  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences
  • Ensure comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and error handling across team services
  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary
  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users
  • Strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations
  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD
  • Good communication skills to prevent risks and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Advanced English skills
  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

title: Senior Data Scientist - Optimization
description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world. In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

About the Role

The Senior Data Scientist – Optimization will be responsible for developing solutions at the intersection of Machine Learning and Advanced Optimization, with a focus on multi-objective, lexicographic, and evolutionary methods. This role will tackle strategic challenges related to delivery optimization, freight rate modeling, and minimum order value determination, integrating demand forecasting and large-scale operational constraints. This person will lead the design and implementation of mixed-integer optimization algorithms ensuring that solutions are scalable, interpretable, and directly impact key business metrics.

What you'll do:

  • Implement and adapt PaCo (Pareto Ant Colony Optimization) algorithms for integer and mixed-variable optimization problems, addressing multiple objectives and business constraints.
  • Develop and benchmark models based on NSGA-II/III, MOEA/D, Simulated Annealing, CP-SAT, and Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP).
  • Formulate composite objective functions and lexicographic hierarchies to prioritize goals such as logistics cost, service level, and profit margin.
  • Generate short- and mid-term demand forecasts using Machine Learning techniques (regression, ensembles, neural networks, time series) and integrate these forecasts as inputs to optimization models.
  • Build automated pipelines for training, inference, and optimization, ensuring traceability, versioning, and performance using Python, PySpark, MLflow, Docker, and GitHub Actions.
  • Execute and monitor experiments in cloud-based distributed environments (Azure, Databricks), optimizing both computational performance and cost.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to align business criteria, validate results, and ensure the impact of deployed solutions.

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, or related fields. A master’s or PhD in a relevant area is a plus.
  • Experience with multi-objective and lexicographic optimization (PaCo, NSGA-II/III, MOEA/D).
  • Familiarity with optimization frameworks such as Pyomo, OR-Tools, PuLP, PyMoo, Gurobi, or CPLEX.
  • Proficiency in Python and PySpark, with solid use of scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Scikit-learn).
  • Experience integrating ML models with optimization workflows (e.g., using forecasts as parameters in decision models).
  • Advanced English for working in a global environment.
  • Excellent analytical skills, clear communication, and a focus on impactful results.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with route optimization, supply chain, dynamic pricing, or last-mile logistics.
  • Knowledge of hybrid ML + OR methods (e.g., learning to estimate optimization parameters).
  • Experience with Azure Databricks, MLflow, Ray, Airflow, or other distributed computing platforms.
  • Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in multi-objective optimization.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. description:
SOBRE NÓS

A Brudovan Pneus foi fundada em 1973, na cidade de Campinas, pelo Sr. Domenico Micaroni e atualmente, a empresa é liderada por seus filhos, Domenico Micaroni Junior e Bruno Micaroni. Atuamos no comércio varejista e atacadista de peças, pneus e serviços, consolidando nossa presença em diferentes segmentos do mercado. Desde o início, com apenas uma loja de Auto Center, já contávamos com uma equipe de operações e de vendas altamente capacitada e atuávamos em um mercado em franca expansão. Esses fatores foram cruciais para nosso rápido crescimento e sucesso. Atualmente, possuímos quatro lojas na região de Campinas. Além disso, somos distribuidores exclusivos de pneus Michelin e óleo Castrol para motocicletas no estado de São Paulo. Expandimos nossas operações para outros estados estratégicos. Em Minas Gerais, o segundo maior mercado consumidor do Brasil, trabalhamos com marcas renomadas como Michelin, Levorin e Cobreq. No estado da Bahia, somos os distribuidores exclusivos da Motul. Nosso destaque no setor é evidente: somos o maior distribuidor de pneus Michelin do Brasil e estamos entre os três principais distribuidores da Levorin no país. Em nível internacional, figuramos entre os cinco maiores distribuidores Michelin 2R na América Latina.

Responsável por garantir o cumprimento das metas de vendas, desenvolver estratégias comerciais regionais, ampliar a carteira de clientes e fortalecer o relacionamento com distribuidores, varejistas e oficinas especializadas.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform how food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We are partnering with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing fast. Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We are proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil where the real climate impact happens.

About The Role

Role: COO to lead go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors, and to evolve our operational backbone. You will oversee the entire value chain—from mineral inputs and field operations to the internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

Location & Travel: Hybrid, with travel in Brazil. Language skills: Portuguese, English (fluent). Start date: Ideally Q3/Q4 2025.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to national impact in agriculture and mining; a 1-100 leadership role requiring bold strategy and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil with scalability in mind.
  • Translate carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement via operational KPIs, systemisation, and data-driven performance.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Impact Officer, Head of Operations, and VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and operational goals.
  • Lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling to ensure product-market fit.
  • Build cross-functional alignment to ensure the product offers agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements; orchestrate the 1-100 scale-up journey.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm; ensure compliance with carbon standards and farmer requirements.
  • Support legal to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
  • Lead a large and growing team across Brazil and globally; collaborate with Carbon, Science, and Technology teams and strategic partners.

Team & Culture

  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable; turn high performers into high-impact owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You have scaled something from messy beginnings to market success—ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic—able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Sobre a oportunidade:

Como uma pessoa Gerente Tributária - Preços de Transferência você será parte da área de Tax atuando com foco em TP (Preços de Transferência) e apoiando na definição de preços dos produtos produzidos no exterior e vendidos no Brasil. Prestará assessoria tributária para atendimento às regras de preços de transferência realizando revisão, documentação, gerenciamento e defesa das políticas de TP, além da preparação de cálculos e documentos pertinentes para o cumprimento de obrigações principais e acessórias.

Você assumirá as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e realizar análises de preços de transferência sob a ótica das diretrizes da OCDE;
  • Liderar e coordenar projetos globais ou regionais de documentação de preços de transferência envolvendo diversas jurisdições (CbCR, Master File, Local File e Benchmark);
  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar políticas de preços de transferência para empresas multinacionais brasileiras e internacionais;
  • Atuar em projetos de auditoria e due diligence para realizar revisões sob a ótica de preços de transferência;
  • Desenvolver a equipe nas melhores práticas de preços de transferência;
  • Auxiliar nos processos de auditoria de preços de transferência de clientes;
  • Participar de processos de procedimento amigável e acordos antecipados de preços;
  • Efetuar diagnóstico das operações sujeitas às regras de preços de transferência e métodos aplicáveis, realizando business modelings quando necessário;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições;
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamento de trabalho produtivo com os profissionais dos clientes e avaliar a satisfação dos serviços prestados;
  • Entender as linhas de serviço da EY e incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços que podemos oferecer aos nossos clientes.

Requisitos e habilidades que buscamos:

  • Experiência na área de preços de transferência (in house ou Big4);
  • Graduação em economia, contabilidade ou administração;
  • Mestrado em administração, finanças ou áreas correlatas (desejável);
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente;
  • Espanhol desejável;
  • Habilidade avançada na comunicação verbal e escrita.

Acesse go.ey.com/beneficios e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

O que oferecemos:

Na EY, você se desenvolve com habilidades voltadas para o futuro e se abastece de experiências de classe mundial. Nós capacitaremos você em um ambiente flexível e potencializaremos seus talentos extraordinários em uma cultura diversa e inclusiva, com equipes globalmente conectadas.

Pelo 4o ano consecutivo, a EY está na lista do Great Place to Work como uma das melhores empresa para se trabalhar, com destaque para as categorias de diversidade. Você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

A Security, líder em gestão de pessoas com 45 anos de história no mercado, está em busca de talentos para integrar sua equipe operacional. Com mais de 8.000 colaboradores em todo o país e atuação em mais de 900 municípios, oferecemos uma oportunidade única para você fazer a diferença em um ambiente que valoriza ética, profissionalismo e segurança. Atividades Específicas

  1. Relatar os fatos ocorridos durante o período de vigilância à chefia imediata.
  2. Controlar a movimentação e permanência de pessoas, veículos e bens materiais, realizando identificação e registros quando necessário.

  • Desconto em faculdade

Com 46 anos de experiência em Vigilância Patrimonial, Facilities, Limpeza e Tecnologia, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 6.500 colaboradores, distribuídos por 11 estados e presentes em mais de 900 municípios, consolidando nossa atuação em todo o país.

Somos vencedores do Prêmio Valor Carreira – As Melhores na Gestão de Pessoas – por sete vezes, reconhecidos como uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar pelo GPTW (Great Place To Work) por quatro anos consecutivos e certificados pelo Selo Segurança Sem Preconceito.

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos.

Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

Na Odontoclinic, você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é, crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

Sobre a Odontoclinic

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. Aqui, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento de pessoas é o caminho para construir resultados sustentáveis. Por isso, investimos constantemente em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

Na Odontoclinic, você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é, crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui.

NICE TO HAVES

Sobre o cargo

Você é defensor(a) da nossa marca. Nesta função, e juntamente com a equipa, irá:

  • Realizar as tarefas de Contabilidade, emissão de NF série 01e D1 e enviar os documentos fiscais ao escritório/ Pryor (NF´s , leitura X e leitura z) a fim de garantir o funcionamento dos procedimentos fiscais na boutique.

  • Informar através do email e fax, a chegada de boletos bancários na boutique, e enviar posteriormente ao setor de contas as pagar.
  • Outras tarefas de rotina da área

Sobre você

Você é Um(a) Pessoa De Caixa Excecional, Que Nos Oferece

  • um excelente sentido de moda e uma verdadeira paixão pela nossa marca e os nossos produtos;
  • experiência/forte interesse nas marcas de moda/cosmética/estilo de vida de luxo;

O que oferecemos

  • Descontos em produtos Swarovski
  • Programa de Assistência ao Funcionário

  • Programas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento

Sobre a Swarovski

A Swarovski produz produtos à base de cristal de qualidade e habilidade artística impecáveis que trazem alegria e celebram a individualidade. Fundada em 1895 na Áustria, a empresa desenha, fabrica e vende sofisticados cristais, pedras preciosas, diamantes e zircônias fabricadas e acessórios, bem como objetos de cristal e acessórios para a casa. A Swarovski Crystal Business tem alcance global com aproximadamente 2.400 lojas e 6.700 pontos de vendas em cerca de 140 países e emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas. Junto com suas empresas irmãs, a Swarovski Optik (dispositivos ópticos) e a Tyrolit (abrasivos), a Swarovski Crystal Business compõe o Swarovski Group. Uma relação saudável com as pessoas e com o planeta é parte da herança da Swarovski. Hoje, esse legado se fundamenta em medidas de sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia de valor, com ênfase na inovação circular, defendendo a diversidade, inclusão e autoexpressão, e no trabalho filantrópico da Swarovski Foundation, que apoia organizações de caridade que provocam um impacto ambiental e social positivo.

Swarovski é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades. Oferemos à nossa equipe a coragem de celebrar a individualidade e o orgulho de criar um local de trabalho onde as pessoas se sintam envolvidas, respeitadas, valorizadas, conectadas e ouvidas. title: It operations analyst
description:
Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high‑code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning. We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak. With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast. We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation.

Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands‑on problem‑solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and clear communication.

Responsibilities

  • Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de‑provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools).
  • Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, and warranties.
  • Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly.
  • Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing).
  • Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching).
  • Support onboarding and off‑boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist).
  • Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, and policies.
  • Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts).
  • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g., deeper system issues).

Requisitos

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.
  • Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist).
  • Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g., Google Workspace, SSO, IAM).
  • Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow).
  • Hands‑on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks.
  • Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security.
  • Experience with inventory / asset management systems.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work autonomously.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese – Fluent.
  • English – Advanced.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks.
  • Exposure to security best practices (patch management, endpoint protection).
  • Prior experience in an early‑stage, high‑growth, and fast‑paced startup environment or technology companies.

Employment Details

  • Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level
  • Employment type: Full‑time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Human Resources Services

Somos especialistas em transformação tecnológica , unindo expertise humana à IA para criar soluções tech escaláveis. Com mais de 7 .400 CI&Ters ao redor do mundo, já formamos parcerias com mais de 1.000 clientes durante nossos 30 anos de história. Inteligência Artificial é nossa realidade.

Importante : se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

Descrição da Vaga

Espera-se que você seja capaz de mergulhar em conjuntos de dados complexos, provenientes de diversas fontes, e transformá-los em informações claras e acionáveis que nortearão as decisões estratégicas dos nossos clientes.

Buscamos um perfil que combine excelência técnica com uma forte visão de negócios, capaz de não apenas manipular e analisar dados, mas também de comunicar os resultados de forma eficaz para diferentes públicos, incluindo lideranças executivas.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Análise de Dados: Coletar, processar e analisar grandes volumes de dados de fontes variadas (estruturadas e não estruturadas) para identificar tendências, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Geração de Insights: Desenvolver análises aprofundadas e modelos que gerem insights estratégicos para os negócios dos clientes.
  • Comunicação Executiva: Criar e apresentar relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados de forma clara, concisa e impactante para stakeholders e executivos.
  • Autonomia e Proatividade: Trabalhar de forma independente na gestão de projetos de análise de dados, desde a concepção e planejamento até a entrega dos resultados.
  • Colaboração: Atuar em colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e especialistas de negócio, para garantir a entrega de soluções de alto valor.
  • Mentoria: Contribuir para o desenvolvimento técnico de outros membros da equipe, compartilhando conhecimentos e melhores práticas.

Qualificações e Requisitos

  • Experiência Comprovada: Sólida experiência profissional como Analista de Dados ou em posições similares.
  • Ferramentas de Análise: Domínio em SQL para extração e manipulação de dados.
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python ou R para análise de dados.
  • Visualização de Dados: Experiência com criação de camadas semânticas e ferramentas de visualização, preferencialmente PowerBI, e similares para a criação de dashboards interativos.
  • Conhecimento em Estatística: Sólida base em conceitos estatísticos e sua aplicação em análises de negócio.
  • Visão de Negócios: Habilidade para entender os desafios de negócio e traduzi-los em problemas de dados.
  • Comunicação e Storytelling: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de contar histórias com dados.
  • Independência: Perfil proativo, com capacidade de autogestão e tomada de decisão.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ambientes de cloud (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital.
  • Experiência comprovada com Azure/Databricks.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Fabric
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale alimentação e refeição;

  • Parceria com academias e profissionais de saúde e bem-estar via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;

  • Plataforma de aprendizagem contínua (CI&T University);
  • Plataforma online gratuita dedicada à promoção da saúde física, mental e bem-estar;
  • Curso gestante e parentalidade responsável;
  • E muitos outros

title: Critical Environment Field Service Engineer (CEFSE)
description:
Critical Environment Field Service Engineer (CEFSE)

Join to apply for the Critical Environment Field Service Engineer (CEFSE) role at Microsoft Power Platform Community

Business Function Overview

In alignment with Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day. As a CO+I CE Field Service Engineer, you will deliver core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform.

Responsibilities

  • Ensures compliance with data center business units and service-level policies.
  • Engages with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
  • Manages programs associated with area of responsibility.
  • Demonstrates conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keeps costs reasonable and contributes to staying within budget.
  • Follows and adheres to safety and security policies and procedures. Reports immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
  • Participates in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.
  • Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability in conjunction with our landlord partners at our leased Datacenters and to ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our leased Datacenters.
  • Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year.
  • Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives.
  • Support delivery of the Datacenter’s Emergency Preparedness and Response plans and act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within our leased datacenters.
  • Coordinate, plan, schedule, and supervise CE audits and compliance verification as needed.
  • Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring.
  • Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and Landlord partners (including contributing to MBRs, QBRs).
  • Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio.
  • Hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service).
  • Supports escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent AND 2+ year(s) industry experience in a datacenter or other critical environment facility.
  • OR 3+ years industry experience and college course work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years’ experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services.
  • Experience working on large scale CE projects.
  • Experience with the operation of IT infrastructure (Servers, SANs, Networking, etc.).

Background Check Requirements

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Equal Opportunity

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form.

Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.

Sua missão:

description:
2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Please note that this role works 100% on-site. About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user-centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end-users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

What you'll do:
  • Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;
  • Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows;
  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short-term feature delivery with long-term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;
  • Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator-friendly experiences;
  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;
  • Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement;
  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI-driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.
What you'll need:
  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);
  • Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains;
  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data-centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud-based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade-offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business-focused.
More about you:
  • You’re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.
What We Offer:
  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

description:
SOBRE NÓS

A Brudovan Pneus foi fundada em 1973, na cidade de Campinas, pelo Sr. Domenico Micaroni e atualmente, a empresa é liderada por seus filhos, Domenico Micaroni Junior e Bruno Micaroni. Atuamos no comércio varejista e atacadista de peças, pneus e serviços, consolidando nossa presença em diferentes segmentos do mercado. Desde o início, com apenas uma loja de Auto Center, já contávamos com uma equipe de operações e de vendas altamente capacitada e atuávamos em um mercado em franca expansão. Esses fatores foram cruciais para nosso rápido crescimento e sucesso. Atualmente, possuímos quatro lojas na região de Campinas. Além disso, somos distribuidores exclusivos de pneus Michelin e óleo Castrol para motocicletas no estado de São Paulo. Expandimos nossas operações para outros estados estratégicos. Em Minas Gerais, o segundo maior mercado consumidor do Brasil, trabalhamos com marcas renomadas como Michelin, Levorin e Cobreq. No estado da Bahia, somos os distribuidores exclusivos da Motul. Nosso destaque no setor é evidente: somos o maior distribuidor de pneus Michelin do Brasil e estamos entre os três principais distribuidores da Levorin no país. Em nível internacional, figuramos entre os cinco maiores distribuidores Michelin 2R na América Latina.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Planejar e executar ações de Trade Marketing voltadas ao canal de distribuição de peças, pneus e lubrificantes de motos, garantindo a visibilidade das marcas, aumento das vendas e fortalecimento da presença nos pontos de venda (PDVs). Liderar e gerenciar as atividades de pós-venda, garantindo a satisfação dos clientes, fidelização e o suporte técnico necessário.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e executar as estratégias de marca, campanhas e ações promocionais que reforçam o posicionamento da empresa e de seus fabricantes parceiros, impulsionando a demanda (sell-out) e fortalecendo a visibilidade nos canais de venda.
  • Planejamento e execução de campanhas: Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de Trade Marketing para impulsionar o giro de produtos nos canais de venda, desde ações internas, externas e eventos envolvendo fornecedores, clientes e time comercial.
  • Gestão do calendário de trade marketing: feirões, ativações em lojas, visitas técnicas, materiais para PDV, ações promocionais e merchandising.
  • Criação e acompanhamento de conteúdos: redes sociais, catálogos, folders, e-mail marketing, vídeos e campanhas digitais.
  • Apoio ao time comercial: materiais para vendas, catálogos, apresentações, banners, totens e visuais para lojas/clientes.
  • Gestão do orçamento de marketing: controle de verba cooperada com fabricantes; Monitoramento do desempenho das campanhas promocionais, analisando dados estratégicos, KPIs comerciais e ROI das ações desenvolvidas.
  • Relacionamento com fornecedores: gráficas, agências, produtoras, influenciadores e prestadores de trade.
  • Gestão de eventos e patrocínios: convenções, feiras do setor, treinamentos técnicos e encontros com clientes.
  • Branding e reputação: alinhamento do posicionamento institucional e visual.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de vendas, logística e técnica para garantir agilidade e precisão no atendimento.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais sobre desempenho da área e indicadores de atendimento.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando (Marketing, Administração, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência em Trade Marketing, preferencialmente no setor automotivo ou de motopeças.
  • Conhecimento em merchandising, ativação de PDV e análise de indicadores de vendas.
  • Experiência em Campanhas e ações de mkt com intuito de potencializar resultados no depto comercial.
  • Experiência no suporte e atendimento ao cliente.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user‑centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high‑performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end‑users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

What you’ll do:

  • Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;
  • Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows;
  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short‑term feature delivery with long‑term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;
  • Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator‑friendly experiences;
  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;
  • Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement;
  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI‑driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.

What you’ll need:

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);
  • Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains;
  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data‑centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud‑based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade‑offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business‑focused.

More about you:

  • You’re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We Offer:

  • Performance‑based bonus*
  • Attendance bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

Sobre a ODONTOCLINIC

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Tudo isso é possível porque temos um time incrível por trás de cada resultado.

Somos a primeira rede de franquias odontológicas do país e, ao longo dos anos, já recebemos reconhecimentos como o Troféu Excelência em Franchising da ABF e como uma das Melhores Franquias do Brasil pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios. Também fomos eleitos, por seis anos consecutivos, como a clínica com o melhor atendimento do Brasil no segmento odontológico pelo Reclame Aqui.

Aqui, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento de pessoas é o caminho para construir resultados sustentáveis. Investimos constantemente em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

A Odontoclinic oferece um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, vem ser Odontocliniquer!

Assessoria de Investimentos: Começo de carreira | Campinas

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar na cidade de Campinas, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Graduação superior cursando (a partir do 5º semestre) ou completa;
  • Se ainda estiver na faculdade, é necessário estar em um curso noturno;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
    *Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  • Etapa de case: Onde você poderá demonstrar sua visão estratégica e tomada de decisão na construção de soluções para um cliente.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.
